notices.text: World planted: three cyclic families. Food regrows from an external supply.
Staged introduction: 24 Protected cells planted; occupants replaced, energy supplied.
Protected disappeared (census). No automatic rescue.
Staged introduction: 24 Hunter cells planted; occupants replaced, energy supplied.
Hunter disappeared (census). No automatic rescue.
Seasonal drought: one patch, 120 ticks. Food renewal slows; no cells are directly killed.
Rain returns: drought patch begins refilling.
